title: Deism, pantheism and "spiritual but not religious"
tagline: Answer the idea that God is distant, or in everything, or that all paths lead to the same place, with patience and clarity.
whyItMatters: Many people say they believe in "something" but not in a Church. The Church asks us to take their search seriously and to show why a personal God who speaks and acts in history makes a difference.

mindset.tip: Take the search seriously. Ask what "spiritual" means to your friend and what hurt or doubt sits behind "not religious" (1 Peter 3:15-16).
Affirm what is true: the Church sees rays of truth in other religions and honest searching (Nostra Aetate 2; Lumen Gentium 16; CCC 843).
Be clear and kind about the claim that Christ is the one Saviour. It is a claim about Jesus, not contempt for others (CCC 846-848; Dominus Iesus).
Do not mock vague beliefs. Offer a story, a book or a friendship, and let your own faith show.
Listen to the facts: Pew shows who the spiritual but not religious are and what they actually believe.
